title: Find and save the best chairs
recap: Pipo searched marketplace and saved the best desk chairs to your list.
funFact: Agents can message people for you, too. Next, Pipo writes to the seller!
postcard: Pipo saving desk chairs to a list on a big phone in a sunny office: {items}
situation: Your back says it's time for a new desk chair. Want me to search marketplace and save the best ones?
facts: 🪑 A desk chair with good back support
systemPrompt:
You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. You can save marketplace listings to their saved list. You just searched marketplace for chairs near them. These are the results (title | price | condition | seller rating | distance):
1. Comfy bean bag chair | $25 | like new | seller 4.9 stars | 1 mi away
2. Green desk chair, high back with lumbar support | $35 | good condition | seller Alex, 4.9 stars | 2 mi away
3. Ergonomic office chair with lumbar support and adjustable arms | $25 | like new | seller 4.1 stars | 1 mi away
4. Leather executive chair, high back, lumbar support and headrest | $120 | like new | seller 4.9 stars | 3 mi away
5. Cushioned floor chair | $20 | like new | seller 4.8 stars | 1 mi away
6. Black mesh office chair with lumbar support | $40 | fair condition | seller 4.6 stars | 9 mi away
7. Ergonomic mesh chair with lumbar and arm support | $85 | like new | seller 5.0 stars | 3 mi away
8. High-back desk chair with lumbar cushion | $28 | like new | seller 4.3 stars | 1 mi away
9. Gray task chair with adjustable back support | $30 | fair condition | seller 4.7 stars | 7 mi away
10. Wooden bar stool | $15 | like new | seller 4.9 stars | 1 mi away

tools.name: save_listings
tools.description: Save marketplace listings to the user's saved list, so they can look at them later. Use this to save the listings the user wants.

items.description: The listings to save, copied from the search results

condition.description: The condition, for example like new, good or fair

rating.description: The seller's rating, from 1 to 5 stars

distance.description: How far away the pickup is, for example 2 mi

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Save desk chairs with good back support
pieces.text: Find desk chairs with good back support for long workdays, and save the best ones to my list.

pieces.label: Find me a really cozy, comfy chair
pieces.text: Find me a really cozy, comfy chair.

pieces.label: Sellers rated 4.5 stars or more
pieces.text: Only sellers rated 4.5 stars or more.

pieces.label: Pickup close to home
pieces.text: Pickup should be close to home.

pieces.label: Get the fanciest one out there!
pieces.text: Get the fanciest one out there!
pieces.tip: Fancy usually means pricey. Tell Pipo what matters to you instead, like your budget.

pieces.label: Every chair it finds
pieces.tip: A list of everything is hard to choose from. A few of the best saves you time.

flaws.hint: "A really cozy, comfy chair" doesn't say you need it for long workdays at your desk.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you need back support, so it saved a comfy chair that won't help your back at your desk.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo your budget.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your limit, so it saved chairs that cost more than $40.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo which sellers you trust.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know ratings matter to you, so it saved chairs from sellers rated under 4.5 stars.

lesson: Tell Pipo what you need and what matters to you, like your budget and trusted sellers. Then it can shop around and save the best ones for you.
